name: Boutique de jardinage
unlock: Available after the first jardining tutorial route.
hours: Check during normal daytime town errands.
notes: Best first stop before culture-profit planning. Pair seed buys with a short-session culture route.

name: Atelier de meubles
unlock: Follow Bob's meubles route and early joinery requetes.
hours: Plan this stop before maison-design sessions.
notes: Main handoff for maison layouts, material planning, and room-by-room design ideas.

name: Animalerie
unlock: Use the animal de compagnie-soin onboarding path before broad nourriture tests.
hours: Visit when routing cats, dogs, and birdwatching unlocks.
notes: Keep animal de compagnie-boutique cats and dogs separate from sauvage mangeoires animales and Oak-Oak.

name: Boutique de vetements
unlock: progression Dorothy's mode and poster route.
hours: Combine with Ville centrale PNJ cadeau loops.
notes: Useful for mode collection checks and seasonal outfit planning.

name: Boutique de musique d'Annie
unlock: Use after sheet-musique and home-decoration systems appear.
notes: Connects maison design with musique collection and room-theme planning.

name: Magasin general de Ka Ching
unlock: Visit when inventory pressure starts blocking routes.
hours: Pair with any long gathering, peche, or evenement loop.
notes: Use this before material-heavy routes so peche and foraging sessions do not stall.

name: Chariot meteo de Doris
unlock: Appears around special meteo states, rainbows, snow, or meteor routes.
hours: Patch-sensitive; confirm with the in-jeu carte and meteo forecast.
notes: Treat Doris as a dynamique merchant. Do not plan rare purchases without checking meteo first.

name: Stand de peche en mer
unlock: Use during Sea Poissonsing and peche-evenement routes.
hours: Check when the evenements page points to peche prep.
notes: Best paired with poisson suivi, inventory checks, and evenement recompense planning.
